decisions.reason: Plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call identified as sole crash (TypeError at render); alpha.2 contract dropped it in favor of useSessionStatus while useSessions stays; B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; single-crash coupling asserted.

Explains via dock-render-tree: one list slot under one shared DrawerErrorBoundary, child throw unmounts whole subtree so B chips vanish with A strip; attach button survives in conversation.input.left under a different boundary; console log cited.

Disable-A experiment proves A caused the unmount and B renders when freed; explicitly does not prove B fully alpha.2-compatible elsewhere nor that A's crash is the only dock defect; reinstalling B pointless; colleague both-props theory refuted on four counts.

Corrected component reads pending via useSessionStatus().pendingInteraction with typeof-guarded seat selection and stable empty fallback so a missing seat is never called; only pending indicators hide while running/todos/token/ETA keep working; silent degradation justified by shared-boundary blast radius.

Verify via client refresh without host restart, both entries render, B paste/remove/re-paste regression with A enabled; hygiene: defensive destructuring, optional local per-entry boundary, host-side per-entry boundaries with nesting/visibility trade-off discussed.
